note: BH-9125. The replay and attempt window of a stage-canary call whose caller named a day fp (canary:<runner>:<account>:<UTC day>, from bin/claude-auth-check.sh and bin/lane-probe.sh --endpoint). The fp itself ends the day, so the window only has to cover it. Every other call keeps AGENT_LEDGER_WINDOW_S. Read as ${AGENT_LEDGER_CANARY_WINDOW_S:-86400}; code fallback ACL_DEF_CANARY_WINDOW_S.
